description: Day8 v2 post-development frozen controlled main benchmark rewritten for frozen QWeather 30-day snapshot, relative-date/no-date expressions, intercity rail budget labels, and multi-agent scheduling/reuse evaluation. This dataset is the paper's main controlled benchmark, not a fully unseen test set.

claim_policy.paper_label_zh: 开发后冻结的受控主基准
claim_policy.paper_wording_required: 论文中应称为开发后冻结的受控主基准，不得称为完全未见测试集。

annotation_policy.day8_weather_policy: Trip plans with an explicit start_date must use the frozen QWeather snapshot. Trip plans without an explicit date must not use concrete weather and must remind users to check weather before departure. Weather-only no-date queries may default to the near-term forecast according to tool policy. Weather-adjustment scenarios ctp100_v2_070-074 reuse first-turn weather evidence and must not rerun weather_query on the adjustment turn.
annotation_policy.intercity_budget_policy: origin present uses frozen adult second-class high-speed/D-train round-trip fare when supported; missing origin or unsupported route must not guess fare.
